parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 Which is the girl’s mother?

Girl: Oh look, my mum’s over there. Can you see her?

Boy: I’ve never met your mum. Is she the one with the raincoat and the striped scarf?

Girl: Well, she’s got a coat and a scarf, but it’s not striped, it’s got flowers on. And she usually wears glasses, but she doesn’t have them on today.

Boy: Oh yes, I can see her!

2 What is in the girl’s pencil case?

Dad: Have you got everything in your pencil case?

Girl: Yes, everything I need. A pen of course. And the teacher doesn’t like it if we don’t have a ruler, so I’ve always got one. And I never forget my pencil!

Dad: But not a rubber? I can get you one if you like.

Girl: It’s OK, I don’t need one. I never make mistakes!

3 What job does the boy’s father do?

Girl: So, does your dad travel a lot in his job?

Boy: Well, sort of, but not very far. He often takes people to the airport, or picks them up from the stadium after matches.

Girl: Does he like chatting to his passengers then?

Boy: Of course! Once he even had a famous footballer in his car, who had his own plane!

4 What was the problem in the bathroom?

Boy: We’ve got a problem in our bathroom at home.

Girl: What happened?

Boy: Well, our washing machine is in the bathroom. Yesterday, water started coming out of it and going onto the floor. I thought about using toilet paper to clean up the water, but I didn’t want to use it all. So I used a towel instead. But I couldn’t stop the water and it went down through the floor and into the kitchen below.

Girl: Oh no!

5 Where are the people?

Mum: What would you like us to get for supper tonight?

Son: I’d like steak and chips, like we had in that restaurant last week.

Mum: All right. Could you help me?

Son: Sure. Let’s get potatoes, and make our own chips.

Mum: OK. You stay here by the vegetables and find some. I’ll get the meat from over there. I’ll be two minutes. And it’ll be better than that restaurant!
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Mum: Hi, it’s mum. Look, today is grandad’s birthday, April the thirtieth. I’m so sorry, I forgot to tell you this morning. Your uncle is giving a surprise party for him. It’s at a hotel called the Yeovil, I’ll spell that, it’s Y-E-O-V-I-L. I don’t think you’ve ever been there, so I’ll give you the address. It’s number fifty-seven Airport Road. It’s just before the roundabout where Forest Road joins. Can you come straight from school to the party please? You finish today at three-thirty don’t you? so can you get to the hotel at quarter past four. You’ll have enough time. I’ve checked online and there’s a bus that takes you from just by your school straight there. It’s the 84, make sure you get that one, not the 85. The 85 goes the other way, so don’t get that one. And I forgot to bring my mobile today, so call me at work if you need to. The number is 0double1723879double2. Thanks love, Grandad will be so pleased to see you!
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

You will hear two classmates discussing a talk about maths in daily life.

Boy: Did you like that talk?

Girl: Yeah. My friends decided not to go. They said, ‘Well, the teacher said we don’t have to go’. But I’m glad I did.

Boy: Me too. I like using maths. For example if my family are driving somewhere, 90 kilometers away, I like guessing what time we’ll arrive. But it’s always hard, because some roads are fast, and others are slow.

Girl: Everyone knows maths helps you check prices when you’re buying food.

Boy: Or deciding how much paint you need for a wall or a room.

Girl: Yeah. But I never knew it helps tennis players know exactly where to hit the ball. That was amazing!

Boy: Actually, I’ll need maths tomorrow. I have a recipe but I’m making a bigger cake, so everything’s double. So, not 175 grammes of butter, but … .

Girl: 350?

Boy: Very good! Without changing the cooking time.

Girl: Or temperature?

Boy: Exactly. What do you think about studying maths at university?

Girl: Me? Well, I’m only 13. I might start university when I’m 18. That’s still a long time. I’ll talk about it with my parents when I’m older.
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a boy and his mother talking about a drink.

What does the boy’s mother want to know?

Mother: Are you drinking another can of lemonade? You must really like it!

Boy: Yeah, but I don’t drink the unhealthy stuff. This can’s low in sugar.

Mother: Oh, I’m pleased to hear that. How many grammes in a hundred milliliters of lemonade? Can I see the can?

Boy: Here you are.

Mother: Thanks … Yeah, you were right. It’s not so high!

17 You will hear two classmates discussing a friend called Maria.

What are they discussing?

Girl: Have you seen Maria? She’s got a new haircut.

Boy: Again? She only went to the hairdresser’s about a week ago! Perhaps she wasn’t happy with it?

Girl: Maybe, but her hairdresser doesn’t charge her much, so she can afford to go a lot.

Boy: Yeah, she really loves changing her hair all the time. Either getting it cut shorter or trying a new style.

Girl: She looks amazing!

18 You will hear a boy talking about the gym he goes to.

What does he say about it?

Boy: Yeah, I use the gym. It’s often quite busy, but hardly anyone’s ever on the machine I use most, so that’s cool! But time goes really slowly. I mean, I sit there, look at myself in the mirror, doing the same thing again and again. So I stop after 5 minutes. It’s the same with the other machines. It’s a bit boring but it’s good to do exercise.

19 You will hear a girl telling her father about a school trip.

What was the problem on the trip?

Father: How was your class trip to the coast?

Girl: Brilliant! Except Rosana felt really sick on the way, so the coach had to stop for her for a few minutes.

Father: Oh. How was the beach?

Girl: Great. We went for a walk. Our map stopped us getting lost, but there wasn’t much time before we had to go back to the coach.

20 You will hear a school teacher talking to her class.

What subject is the lesson?

Teacher: Istanbul is Europe’s largest city, and in fact, it used to be the largest in the world, in the seventeenth century. It had about seven hundred thousand people. But now, it has fifteen million. Although most of them live in Europe, about one third live in Asia, because the city is actually in two continents, Europe and Asia.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Boy: Hi Sunita, what did you get for your birthday?

Girl: Lina got me a chess board and pieces.

Boy: Cool! What else?

Girl: Amelia and I love the same writer, so she got me his latest. It’s a story about a guy cycling around the world.

Boy: How about Rajiv? Didn’t he get you sports shoes?

Girl: Well, no, they’re an expensive present. He got me some tennis balls because we’re playing a game later!

Boy: Oh, good luck!

Girl: And Daisy got me a bracelet and necklace, like my favourite singer had at a concert we went to. We both really liked them!

Boy: What about your family?

Girl: Uncle Rick’s crazy about rugby and wants me to play. He gave me a rugby ball last year. And this year he got me some boots to play the game.

Boy: Can’t you wear those for football, too?

Girl: Yeah, I will. And Grandma – she worries about me when I’m cycling. She says I mustn’t wear jewellery or listen to music on my bike.

Boy: OK.

Girl: … but I must have lights. So she got me some for it.

Boy: It sounds like you got some cool stuff!

explanations.p1q1: 女孩说妈妈确实有外套和围巾，但 "it’s not striped, it’s got flowers on"，即围巾带花、不是条纹的；她还补充 "she usually wears glasses, but she doesn’t have them on today"，平时戴眼镜今天没戴。A 图是条纹围巾、C 图戴着眼镜，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩说铅笔盒里有一支钢笔，而且 "the teacher doesn’t like it if we don’t have a ruler, so I’ve always got one"，还有 "I never forget my pencil!"；爸爸问要不要橡皮，她答 "It’s OK, I don’t need one."，可见铅笔盒里没有橡皮，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩说爸爸 "often takes people to the airport, or picks them up from the stadium after matches"，还提到 "Once he even had a famous footballer in his car"，女孩也问他是否喜欢和乘客聊天，可见他开车接送乘客，是出租车司机，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q4: 男孩说 "our washing machine is in the bathroom. Yesterday, water started coming out of it and going onto the floor"，水最后 "went down through the floor and into the kitchen below"，可见问题是洗衣机漏水漫过地板、流到了楼下厨房，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 妈妈让孩子 "You stay here by the vegetables and find some"，自己去那边拿肉，两人还打算 "Let’s get potatoes, and make our own chips."，在货架间挑选蔬菜和肉，说明他们在超市，因此选择 C。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 Yeovil。妈妈说派对在一家酒店举行，"It’s at a hotel called the Yeovil, I’ll spell that, it’s Y-E-O-V-I-L"，并逐个字母拼出店名，据此填写 Yeovil。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 Airport。妈妈接着给出酒店地址："It’s number fifty-seven Airport Road."；她后面提到的 "the roundabout where Forest Road joins" 只是描述酒店的位置，不是门牌路名，故填 Airport。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 4:15。妈妈说 "You finish today at three-thirty don’t you? so can you get to the hotel at quarter past four."，即三点半放学后，四点一刻（quarter past four）到酒店，故填 4:15。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 84。妈妈说查过在线信息，有一班车从学校旁直达酒店，"It’s the 84, make sure you get that one, not the 85."，并强调 85 是反方向的、不要坐，故填 84。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 01172387922。妈妈说今天没带手机，有事就 "call me at work"，号码是 "0double1723879double2"，其中 double 表示连续两位相同数字，即 0-1-1-7-2-3-8-7-9-2-2，故填 0117 238 7922。
explanations.p3q1: 女孩说 "My friends decided not to go"，朋友们因为老师说可去可不去而没去这场演讲，但她自己 "I’m glad I did"，很高兴自己去了，因此选择 A；她并不是因为朋友推荐才高兴。
explanations.p3q2: 男孩说全家开车去 90 公里外时 "I like guessing what time we’ll arrive"，但 "it’s always hard, because some roads are fast, and others are slow"，可见他觉得难的是估计一段旅程要花多久（几点能到），因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q3: 女孩说 "Everyone knows maths helps you check prices when you’re buying food"，买涂料是男孩补充的（"Or deciding how much paint you need for a wall or a room."）；她惊讶的是 "I never knew it helps tennis players know exactly where to hit the ball."，即她原来不知道数学对运动（网球）有用，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q4: 男孩说明天要烤更大的蛋糕，"I’m making a bigger cake, so everything’s double."，黄油 "not 175 grammes of butter, but …"（女孩答 350），所有配料分量翻倍；而烘烤 "Without changing the cooking time."，温度也不变，可见数学帮他决定的是需要多少配料，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q5: 男孩问女孩将来对学数学的看法，女孩答 "I’m only 13. I might start university when I’m 18. That’s still a long time."，还说 "I’ll talk about it with my parents when I’m older."，可见她觉得现在考虑上大学还太早，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩说这罐柠檬水 "This can’s low in sugar"，妈妈便拿过罐子问 "How many grammes in a hundred milliliters of lemonade?"，她想确认的正是饮料的含糖量，因此选择 B；妈妈没有问味道，也没有问男孩为什么喜欢它。
explanations.p4q2: 女孩一见面就说 "She’s got a new haircut."，男孩惊讶她一周前才去过理发店；女孩解释 "her hairdresser doesn’t charge her much, so she can afford to go a lot."，男孩补充 "she really loves changing her hair all the time."，两人讨论的是 Maria 为什么频繁换发型，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩说自己常用的那台机器人很少，但 "But time goes really slowly."，因为他 "sit there, look at myself in the mirror, doing the same thing again and again"，5 分钟就停下来；他承认 "It’s a bit boring but it’s good to do exercise."，可见他觉得用健身器械无聊，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说旅途很棒，但 "Rosana felt really sick on the way, so the coach had to stop for her for a few minutes."，即路上有同学晕车、大巴中途停车几分钟，因此选择 C；大巴并没有晚点，而且 "Our map stopped us getting lost"，没人迷路。
explanations.p4q5: 老师介绍 "Istanbul is Europe’s largest city"，讲十七世纪人口约七十万、如今一千五百万，还说 "the city is actually in two continents, Europe and Asia."，内容都是城市、人口与洲的分布等地理知识，因此选择 C。
explanations.p5q1: 女孩说 "Amelia and I love the same writer, so she got me his latest. It’s a story about a guy cycling around the world."，Amelia 送了她们共同喜欢作家的最新书，讲一个人骑车环游世界的故事，对应选项 B（book）。
explanations.p5q2: 男孩猜 "Didn’t he get you sports shoes?"，女孩否认说那太贵，"He got me some tennis balls because we’re playing a game later!"，Rajiv 送的是网球，晚点一起比赛用，对应选项 H（tennis equipment）。
explanations.p5q3: 女孩说 "Daisy got me a bracelet and necklace, like my favourite singer had at a concert we went to."，手链和项链属于首饰，对应选项 E（jewellery）。
explanations.p5q4: Uncle Rick 痴迷橄榄球，"He gave me a rugby ball last year. And this year he got me some boots to play the game."，去年送了橄榄球，今年送的是打橄榄球穿的球鞋，对应选项 G（sports shoes）。
explanations.p5q5: 奶奶担心她骑车时的安全，不许她戴首饰、听音乐，但女孩说 "… but I must have lights. So she got me some for it."，奶奶给她买了自行车灯，对应选项 A（bike lights）。
